name: VoterRecords
instructions: Open https://voterrecords.com, search for {full_name}, open your own record and use the site's opt-out or "Control" link on it. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address. Then press "I've done this".
notes: VoterRecords republishes public voter rolls. The "Record Opt-Out" link is at the bottom of each record and has an hCaptcha. It removes the house number, phone and email from the page; the name stays, because voter rolls are public.
source: Process per redact.dev's VoterRecords removal guide (updated 2026-09-10).
